audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer misgenders Karma as male four times ('his engage cooldown' x2, 'his duo's sustain', 'His answer goes first') despite Karma being female per champ-data/champ-gender.js.
audit.why: Karma is on the female list. The owner (Senna) is 'you', so any third-person pronoun refers to Karma and must be 'her'.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[0].side='Karma' but content win[0]='Skill'; phases[1].side='Skill' but win[1]='Karma'; phases[3].side='Skill' but win[3]='Karma'.
audit.why: Content's whys[] give the specific, kit-grounded reasoning (Karma's Mantra empowers Q from level 1, so her real spike is level 2's RQ burst and levels 4-5's RQ/RE peel — level 1 itself is a mana-honest poke trade, not a Karma spike). Full's phases[0].why is the shared boilerplate ('Q off minions to chip the duo') pasted across every matchup regardless of enemy, so it is the stale/templated side, not the content layer.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0].side to 'Skill' (rating down to 5/10) and phases[1]/phases[3].side to 'Karma' (rating up to 6/10), rewriting each why to match the already-correct content reasoning. win[0,1,3] left untouched since they already read correctly.
